title: Lovely Resinous Brazilian Cheese Lasagna
description: A solo dinner Brazilian dish featuring Dutch stroop and a blend of cheeses, this lasagna is macrobiotic-friendly and offers a resinous, cheese-pull experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the lasagna noodles according to package instructions.
In a mortar and pestle, pound the Dutch stroop into a smooth paste.
In a large bowl, combine the queijo coalho cheese, parmesan cheese, and mozzarella cheese.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the cooked lasagna noodles to the skillet and toss to coat with olive oil.
In a large baking dish, create a layer of noodles, followed by a layer of cheese mixture, and then a layer of Dutch stroop paste.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Sprinkle the chopped parsley and salt over the top layer of cheese.
Bake the lasagna in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
